evals.prompt: Goal: let customers approve sales quotes by replying to an email. Give me the plan in under 300 words; do not run anything.
expectations: States the observable end result beyond the feature itself (e.g. the approved quote reaching the next step such as an order)
Covers failure or edge handling at a handoff, such as stale approvals, duplicate replies, or retry
Recommends one smallest complete approach after comparing at least one alternative (reuse, manual, buy, or build)

evals.prompt: There are 6 open tickets, each fixing one untranslated UI string on a different page of the same web app. How should these be delivered? Answer briefly; do not run anything.
expectations: Groups the six same-root-cause fixes into one change or layer rather than six serial tickets
Says to check the result in the real rendered UI, not only with unit tests

evals.prompt: The unit and integration tests pass for the new invoice sync to the accounting system. Is the feature done? Answer briefly; do not run anything.
expectations: Says passing component tests do not prove the feature works end to end
Calls for exercising the integrated path at real entry points, including a failure or recovery case
Distinguishes implemented or connected from verified
